Name: High Systolic Blood Pressure (ANC)
Criteria: SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_id FROM patient p JOIN obs o ON o.person_id = p.patient_id JOIN concept c ON o.concept_id = c.concept_id WHERE c.uuid IN ('${var.concept.national.blood-pressure-systolic.uuid}', '5085AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA') AND o.value_numeric >= 140 AND o.voided = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs newer JOIN concept newer_c ON newer.concept_id = newer_c.concept_id WHERE newer.person_id = o.person_id AND newer_c.uuid IN ('${var.concept.national.blood-pressure-systolic.uuid}', '5085AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA') AND newer.voided = 0 AND (newer.obs_datetime > o.obs_datetime OR (newer.obs_datetime = o.obs_datetime AND newer.obs_id > o.obs_id)))
Message: High Systolic BP (>=140 mmHg): Evaluate for gestational hypertension / pre-eclampsia

Name: High Diastolic Blood Pressure (ANC)
Criteria: SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_id FROM patient p JOIN obs o ON o.person_id = p.patient_id JOIN concept c ON o.concept_id = c.concept_id WHERE c.uuid IN ('${var.concept.national.blood-pressure-diastolic.uuid}', '5086AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA') AND o.value_numeric >= 90 AND o.voided = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs newer JOIN concept newer_c ON newer.concept_id = newer_c.concept_id WHERE newer.person_id = o.person_id AND newer_c.uuid IN ('${var.concept.national.blood-pressure-diastolic.uuid}', '5086AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA') AND newer.voided = 0 AND (newer.obs_datetime > o.obs_datetime OR (newer.obs_datetime = o.obs_datetime AND newer.obs_id > o.obs_id)))
Message: High Diastolic BP (>=90 mmHg): Evaluate for gestational hypertension / pre-eclampsia

Name: Abnormal Fetal Heart Tone (ANC)
Criteria: SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_id FROM patient p JOIN obs o ON o.person_id = p.patient_id JOIN concept c ON o.concept_id = c.concept_id WHERE c.uuid IN ('${var.concept.ciel.fetal-heart-rate.uuid}', '${var.concept.national.fetal-heart-tone-fht.uuid}') AND (o.value_numeric < 110 OR o.value_numeric > 160) AND o.voided = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs newer JOIN concept newer_c ON newer.concept_id = newer_c.concept_id WHERE newer.person_id = o.person_id AND newer_c.uuid IN ('${var.concept.ciel.fetal-heart-rate.uuid}', '${var.concept.national.fetal-heart-tone-fht.uuid}') AND newer.voided = 0 AND (newer.obs_datetime > o.obs_datetime OR (newer.obs_datetime = o.obs_datetime AND newer.obs_id > o.obs_id)))
Message: Abnormal Fetal Heart Tone (<110 or >160 bpm): Evaluate for fetal distress

Name: Non-vertex Fetal Presentation (ANC)
Criteria: SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_id FROM patient p JOIN obs o ON o.person_id = p.patient_id JOIN concept c ON o.concept_id = c.concept_id JOIN concept answer ON o.value_coded = answer.concept_id WHERE c.uuid IN ('${var.concept.mch.fetal-presentation.uuid}', '${var.concept.national.presentation.uuid}') AND answer.uuid NOT IN ('${var.concept.mch.presentation-vertex.uuid}', '${var.concept.national.vertex.uuid}') AND o.voided = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs newer JOIN concept newer_c ON newer.concept_id = newer_c.concept_id WHERE newer.person_id = o.person_id AND newer_c.uuid IN ('${var.concept.mch.fetal-presentation.uuid}', '${var.concept.national.presentation.uuid}') AND newer.voided = 0 AND (newer.obs_datetime > o.obs_datetime OR (newer.obs_datetime = o.obs_datetime AND newer.obs_id > o.obs_id)))
Message: Non-vertex presentation: Monitor and evaluate presentation for delivery planning
